title: How to Design a Custom Electronics Enclosure That Survives Outdoors
seo_title: Custom Electronics Enclosures Ontario: Outdoor Design Guide
description: Custom electronics enclosures in Ontario fail outdoors for preventable reasons. Water entries, sun, condensation, mounting and service access, planned before the build.
excerpt: Outdoor electronics die from water, sun and condensation, not from circuitry. Plan entries, material, mounting and access first.
